newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Sept exports to be revealed at 1730 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Sept exports to be revealed at 1730 GMT.

text.p: Brazil's Ministry of Industry and Commerce will reveal exports for September at 1430 local/1730 GMT, a spokeswoman said.
The Gazeta Mercantil newspaper reported that exports for the month were expected to come out at about $4.15 billion.
By the end of the third week of September, exports amounted to $2.971 billion, averaging $198 million a day.
But the passage of a bill through Congress exempting exports of primary and semimanufactured goods from tax had been expected to spur a pick-up in shipments.
